meta.name: istio-traffic-management
meta.description: Configure Istio traffic management including routing, load balancing, circuit breakers, and canary deployments. Use when implementing service mesh traffic policies, progressive delivery, or resilience patterns.

copy.tagline: 配置服务网格流量路由与渐进式发布策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你正在用服务网格管理服务间流量,需要安全地滚动发布。
copy.tagline_en: Configure service mesh traffic policies for routing and progressive rollouts.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage service mesh traffic and need safe progressive delivery.

howto.what: Claude 会按 Istio 的 VirtualService、DestinationRule、Gateway 等资源生成 YAML 配置，覆盖路由、灰度发布、熔断与重试、流量镜像、故障注入等模板，并给出 istioctl 排错命令。
howto.when: 当你做服务网格流量策略、渐进式发布或弹性设计时触发，例如配置服务间路由、灰度发布、熔断重试等。

say.text: 给 my-service 配一个带熔断和重试的 DestinationRule
用 istioctl 看看 my-app 当前生效的路由
say.note: 输出路由配置用于排查

howto.what_en: Claude generates Istio YAML for VirtualService, DestinationRule and Gateway resources: routing, canary rollouts, circuit breakers, retries, traffic mirroring, fault injection, plus istioctl debug commands.
howto.when_en: Use when working on service mesh traffic policies, progressive delivery or resilience patterns, such as service-to-service routing, canary rollouts, circuit breakers and retries.

say_en.text: Write a VirtualService sending 90% of reviews traffic to v1 and 10% to v2
Add circuit breaking and retries to a DestinationRule for my-service
Show the routes currently in effect for my-app with istioctl
